title: Eosinophil–neutrophil coupling does not establish improved cross-cycle prediction of adult FEV1
abstract: Adding a standardized absolute eosinophil×neutrophil product did not establish better FEV1 prediction across separately sampled NHANES cycles: source2007–2008 n=3737, target2011–2012 n=3685; target MEC-weighted MSE reduction -31.56 mL² (95% joint source-refit/target PSU-bootstrap interval -1608.28 to 615.34). This is a narrow negative predictive test, not equivalence or evidence against leukocyte biology. AI-authored; author self-checks and clean rerun, not independent peer review.
